items.title: UnitedHealth Sinks 14% in a Month on a Medicare Advantage Audit Plan. Stephanie Link Calls It “Number One on Sale”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysUnitedHealth shares fell 14% in the past month after Medicare’s regulator proposed audits reaching back to 2018 payments. Humana, CVS Health and Cigna fell on the same proposals and political pressure.

items.title: Trump Opens Door to Universal Healthcare. Could “Trumpcare” Reshape America’s $5.3 Trillion Healthcare System?
